晶片端生成式 AI｜人物消除與場景生成

On-device Generative Vision: Person Removal and Scene Synthesis

自主研發 · 互動技術展示

拆解人物遮罩、GAN／Diffusion 修補與晶片端驗證。互動展示提供可重現的合成影像對照。

討論晶片端生成式影像 操作合成影像重建展示

產業問題與工程挑戰

人物消除需要補回被遮住的背景。部署到裝置時，輸出品質、模型所需記憶體和運算成本都要評估。 遮罩誤差、微小遮蔽物與跨幀一致性會改變重建品質。NPU Runtime 支援的算子、動態尺寸、精度與記憶體上限會改變部署選擇。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

示範使用已知乾淨背景、合成人物及可調遮罩。在瀏覽器中以每一列左右可見像素做線性混合，重建遮罩內的區域。此基準法方便觀察遮罩和背景紋理如何影響誤差。

成果

展示可調整遮罩、比較遮擋輸入與還原結果，並計算遮罩內像素誤差。

  • 瀏覽器合成影像重建展示
  • 模型轉換與裝置驗證方法
  • 可供討論的品質及效能驗收規格

驗證與證據

展示計算遮罩內的平均絕對 RGB 誤差，真值來自同一合成場景。裝置研究需另行記錄目標硬體、Runtime、解析度、精度、暖機、端到端 p50／p95 延遲、持續 FPS 與峰值記憶體。

  • 操作合成影像重建展示
  • 晶片端服務與驗收規格

Technical Note

On-device Generative Vision: Person Removal and Scene Synthesis

Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

Examine masks, GAN and diffusion restoration, and chip-level validation. A reproducible synthetic demo lets visitors compare images.

繁體中文 Run the synthetic reconstruction demo

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Removing a person requires reconstructing the background they covered. Device deployment adds constraints on output quality, memory and compute. Mask error, fine occlusions and frame-to-frame consistency affect reconstruction. Operator compatibility, dynamic dimensions, precision and memory limits also affect NPU deployment.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The demo creates a synthetic person over a known clean background and lets visitors adjust the mask. A browser baseline reconstructs masked pixels by linearly blending visible RGB samples on each scanline.

Outcome

Visitors can adjust the mask, compare the occluded input and reconstructed output, and inspect the error inside the mask.

  • Browser-based synthetic reconstruction demo
  • Model conversion and device validation methods
  • Quality and performance acceptance criteria

Validation and evidence

The demo calculates mean absolute RGB error inside the mask, using the original synthetic scene as ground truth. Device studies should record the hardware, runtime, resolution, precision, warmup, end-to-end p50 and p95 latency, sustained FPS and peak memory.

  • Run the synthetic reconstruction demo
  • Edge AI services and validation criteria

Project status and disclosure

Ownership and status
Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

An independent technical note with a synthetic browser baseline. GAN, diffusion and NPU deployment appear in the engineering and validation plan. Customer assets, model weights and hardware measurements are excluded.
